scenes.title: switchboard
scenes.subtitle: A message queue for AI agents across machines

scenes.title: Why switchboard?
bullets: Agents on different machines need to hand work to each other
One hub holds the queue; every machine runs `switchboard watch`
Messages are leased, so a crashed agent never loses a task
Works over tailcat (WireGuard), with no ports open to the internet and a very long bullet that has to wrap onto a second line to test wrapping

scenes.title: How the pieces fit
scenes.caption: One hub owns the queue; workers lease messages over an encrypted tailnet.
